question: What immunity is affirmed for a person even when bitten by great serpents, with respect to poison entering the body?
premises: It does not enter the body.
This holds even for one who has been bitten.
The biting is by great serpents.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body of such a person.
uncertainties: The identity of the person with this immunity is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
